The Garden House

Up to 300 guests Garden + pavilion 4.8 · 64 reviews Verified vendor

A restored 1920s bungalow set in two acres of old trees. Say your vows on the front lawn under the rain tree, then move into the glass pavilion for dinner while fairy lights come on across the garden. Every package includes tables, chairs, a bridal suite for getting ready and a dedicated venue coordinator on the day.

What's included

  • Lawn ceremony setup
  • Bridal getting-ready suite
  • Tables, chairs & linen
  • Fairy-light garden
  • Parking for 80 cars
  • Sound system & dance floor
  • Rain plan in the pavilion
  • Venue coordinator
